extracted.name: Blueberries & Lemon Muffins!! 🫐🍋
extracted.description: Today I’m bringing you these super easy-to-make muffins that are perfect for a delicious weekend breakfast!! You only need basic ingredients that we usually have at home, a lemon, and a few blueberries. I used these cute muffin liners I bought at TJ Maxx and a muffin tray to help support them as they rise (if you buy the sturdy ones, you don’t need to use a muffin tray to bake them, they hold up just fine as they rise 😉). I made a glaze with white chocolate and some blueberries, and it adds such a vibrant pop of color!! Will you give them a try? Come on! I’m looking forward to your cooksnaps! 📸
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp (125 ml) vegetable oil (such as canola)
instruction_lines: Mix the wet ingredients: In a bowl, add the egg yolks (save the whites), sugar, oil, and milk. Mix everything well.
Prepare the dry ingredients: Weigh the flour, then add the salt and baking powder. Stir to combine.
Sift and combine: Sift the dry ingredients into the wet mixture gradually, stirring each time to avoid lumps. You can use a strainer to sift it 😉.
Add lemon flavor: Wash the lemon, zest it, and squeeze the juice. Add both the zest and juice to the mixture.
Whip egg whites: Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold them into the batter to keep it light and fluffy.
Add blueberries: Rinse a handful of blueberries and add them to the batter. Mix gently and store it in the fridge.
Prepare to bake: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C), bottom heat only if possible. Fill muffin liners about ¾ full. Sprinkle a little sugar on top to make a crispy crust!
Bake: Bake until golden and risen. Check with a toothpick—if it comes out clean, they’re done. If not, bake a little longer.

TOPPING (optional): In a microwave-safe cup, combine a handful of white chocolate chips and 2 blueberries. Microwave in 10-second intervals until melted. Stir together and drizzle on top of cooled muffins. You’ll see what a beautiful color it turns out!! Add a few blueberries on top so that when it cools, they stick. Sprinkle a bit of powdered sugar and… done!
This is how the inside turns out: super fluffy, full of flavor, and with a crunchy crust plus the topping… Super yummy!! 😋
